listing.description:
Plain Ink 2027 is a dated 2027 planner for reMarkable 2, Paper Pro and Paper Pure owners who want one planner that fits the screen and works the first time. Every date is linked, and the first page is Monday, October 26, 2026, so you can start this autumn instead of waiting for January. There are no pages for days before October 26.

What's inside: 542 pages in one portrait PDF
- Cover and a Contents page that links every section and month
- Start here: 4 short steps written for reMarkable
- Setup check: buttons that jump and come back, a pen test area and a fix list
- 2027 year at a glance (every date opens its day)
- 12 month pages with a dated grid, This month's focus and Notes
- 12 habit trackers, one for each month of 2027
- 52 week pages with seven day boxes, This week's top 3 and Notes
- 365 day pages
- Head start from Monday, October 26 to December 31, 2026: 2 month pages (November and December), 10 week pages and 67 day pages
- 1 projects page (Project, Next step, Due, Done)
- 10 lined notes pages and 6 dot grid pages

Good to know: portrait only. Weeks start on Monday and use ISO week numbers, so Week 1 is January 4 to 10, 2027; December 28 to January 3 is the last head start week. There is no October month page and no habit tracker for the 2026 head start. No stickers. This is a linked PDF notebook you write in, not a template that installs into the reMarkable template menu, and it does not turn handwriting into text.

What makes it different
- Drawn for e-ink, not shrunk from an iPad planner. Each page is an exact 3:4 portrait page that fills the screen with no gray bands. Pure white paper and grays only, so nothing turns muddy. Lines are thin mid-gray vector strokes that stay visible without fighting your handwriting, and a wider left margin keeps everything clear of the toolbar.
- Working in five minutes, and you can check it. The cover's Open planner button takes you to Start here. The Setup check page lets you tap a few buttons and see the links work on your own tablet before you plan anything. If nothing happens, the fix list is right on that page.
- A time-blocked day with a Top 3. Every day page has Top 3, an 8-line to-do list, time blocks from 6am to 10pm, Notes and Done today, always in the same places. A full page for every day, so there is room for more than one line.
- Start in October, not in January. Head start pages begin on Monday, October 26, 2026 and lead straight into January 2027. Bought it before the 26th? Your first page is that Monday.
- Easy to get around. Month tabs run down the right edge. A top bar takes you Home, to the Year, Projects and Notes. A Month / Week trail works as a back button, every date on a month page opens its day, and day pages have previous and next arrows.
- One focused planner, not a pile of loose templates. Year, month, week and day pages that link to each other, with exact page counts and nothing padded.
- Checked before it ships: pages in strict date order, each week and day once, every link tested, and all text and lines sharp at any zoom.

Works with
- reMarkable 2
- reMarkable Paper Pro
- reMarkable Paper Pure
Not for: the reMarkable Paper Pro Move (its screen is taller and narrower, so this page would not fill it), phones or iPad apps.
No Connect subscription is needed to use it.

How to start
1. Download the PDF from Etsy in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download files.
2. Drag it into the free reMarkable desktop app or my.remarkable.com, or use your tablet's USB web interface.
3. Open it on your tablet, tap the Setup check buttons with your finger, then tap Year and today's date (before 2027, tap Head start on the Year page; the first page is Monday, October 26, 2026). Fill your Top 3.

Questions buyers ask
- The Etsy app won't download it. Use a web browser and go to your purchases. The Etsy app cannot download files.
- How do I get it on my reMarkable? Drag the PDF into the free reMarkable desktop app or my.remarkable.com, or use the USB web interface. No subscription is needed.
- The links don't do anything. Tap with your finger, not the pen. Make sure you opened the PDF you uploaded, not a converted ebook copy. If they still don't work, update your reMarkable software and try again.
- Will it fill my screen? Yes on the reMarkable 2, Paper Pro and Paper Pure. It is not sized for the Paper Pro Move.
- Is it a template for the template menu? No. It is one linked PDF notebook you open and write in.

What you get
- Plain-Ink-2027.pdf (10.8 MB, 542 pages, portrait)
One PDF, not a zip.
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
The Setup check page has a fix list. Still stuck? Send a message through Etsy and name your tablet model.
